class.name: serl_franka_controllers/JointPositionController
class.description: A controller that executes a short motion based on joint positions to demonstrate correct usage

class.name: serl_franka_controllers/JointPositionOscillationController
class.description: A controller that oscillates between two joint position targets using quintic polynomial interpolation

class.name: serl_franka_controllers/CartesianImpedanceController
class.description: A controller that renders a spring damper system in cartesian space. Compliance parameters and the equilibrium pose can be modified online with dynamic reconfigure and an interactive marker respectively.

class.name: serl_franka_controllers/ForceSlideController
class.description: A controller that descends vertically until contact, then slides horizontally while maintaining contact force. Implements a state machine: DESCEND -> SLIDE -> DONE.
